transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. Lately I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can’t hear?
Some evenings, yes. I hear his voice from the hallway or the spare room, plain as day. He tells me I should’ve been there, that I failed him. My wife says the house is quiet, but I hear him.
Have you ever had a period when you felt abnormally high, energetic, or unusually irritable for several days in a row?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had spells where I felt unusually high or full of energy for days.
Did all of this start after someone close to you died?
Yes. It started after my bowling partner died—about a year and a month ago.
Since this started after your bowling partner died, has there been a time when you felt back to your usual self for at least a couple of months?
No. It’s been there since he died, about a year and a month now. I haven’t really felt like my usual self for a stretch like that.
Are your worst thoughts and feelings mostly about your bowling partner’s death?
Not mostly about his death. I keep going over all the things I did wrong with him, and with my family. I just feel like I’m no good to anybody… like I deserve whatever punishment is coming.
Before your bowling partner died, had you ever gone through a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure. I can’t really say whether there was a period like that before he died.
Before your bowling partner died, did you ever have a time lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I honestly can’t remember clearly enough to say. Before he died, I don’t know if I had a stretch like that or not.
Before your bowling partner died, do you remember ever having a two-week period when you felt depressed nearly every day?
I really can’t say for sure. My memory of that time is hazy, and I don’t remember whether it went on for two weeks or not.
Before your bowling partner died, do you remember ever having depression bad enough that you got treatment for it?
I don’t really remember ever getting treatment for depression before then. I can’t say for certain, but nothing comes to mind.
Before your bowling partner died, do you remember ever having a depressive episode like this at any other time in your life?
I’m not sure, doctor. Looking back, I can’t remember another time in my life when it was like this.
Before your bowling partner died, was there ever a time in your life when you were depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I honestly don’t know. I can’t recall a stretch like that clearly enough to say it lasted two weeks.
Before your bowling partner died, do you remember ever having another period in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I can’t say that I do. I’ve tried to think back, but I don’t remember another period that clearly.
At any time before your bowling partner died, did you ever have another episode of depression like this?
I don’t think so. I can’t remember having an episode like this before he died.
